synopsis: Chapter 11 lists OPAL-RT 4DV-SIM and OP5707XG2 among commercial data-replay and hardware-in-the-loop offerings [f8364, f9234]. OP5707XG2 is identified as a CPU/FPGA real-time system, a description repeated in the glossary [f8650, f9236, f16037]. Named off-highway and defense users provide evidence of use, although these facts do not specify users or validation results [f9235, f16037]. Pricing requires a vendor quote, and no latest release was found, leaving cost and release currency unresolved for planning [f8651, f9237, f9238].

relations.note: Both identify OP5707XG2 as combining CPU and FPGA capabilities.
The glossary repeats the named off-highway and defense user evidence.
Both state that pricing for the two OPAL-RT offerings requires a quote.
Both attribute CPU/FPGA real-time capability to OP5707XG2; the latter also names 4DV-SIM.
Specifies the real-time architecture of a listed HIL offering.
Clarifies that the listed OPAL-RT tools are commercial offerings.
Adds quote-only procurement pricing to the commercial-tool classification.
